# spec: Centre High-Mounted Stop Lamp

## Product Type

Centre high-mounted stop lamp (CHMSL, category S3) — additional stop lamp mounted on the vehicle centreline above the rear window, integrated in the roof spoiler.

## Vehicle Category

M1 — passenger car. UNECE lighting regulations referenced apply across M and N categories.

## Function

- Braking indication (supplementary stop lamp, red)
- Light transmission & color definition (outer lens)

## Main Parts

- Outer lens
- Light guide / diffuser
- LED strip on flexible PCB
- Housing
- Mounting bracket
- Wiring harness with connector

## Materials

Representative values — confirm against actual bill of materials.


| Component          | Typical material(s)                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| Outer lens         | PMMA (red-tinted, UV-stabilised)       |
| Diffuser           | PC (frosted)                           |
| Light source       | Red LEDs on polyimide flexible PCB     |
| Housing            | ABS/PC                                 |
| Mounting bracket   | PA6-GF30                               |
| Seal               | Foam tape (PU) or EPDM                 |
| Wiring harness     | PVC-insulated copper, PA connector     |

## Electrical

- Nominal voltage: 12 V DC
- Power consumption: approx. 2.5 W
